caption: For my toddler’s lunch today, I made a Korean traditional banchan called Hobak Jeon (Zucchini Fritters), and here’s the recipe! 1. Slice zucchini into 1/4 inch thick slices 2. Prepare a plastic bag with 3 spoons of flour 3. Place zucchini slices into the plastic bag and shake to coat each slice with flour  4. In a bowl, beat 2 eggs and add 1 tablespoon of sesame oil     5. In a skillet on medium heat, add 1 tablespoon of oil. Once hot, dip one floured zucchini slice into the egg wash and place on the skillet to cook. Continue until the pan is filled  6. Cook on each side until both sides are golden brown (1-2 minutes per side)  I used Eggland’s Best Eggs to enhance taste & for better nutrition – Eggland’s Best Eggs have 6 times more Vitamin D and more than double the Omega-3, with 25% less saturated fat, compared to ordinary eggs.  #toddlermeals #blw #babyledweaning
